# hrm-ringer-snapshot

Vendored implementation, independently installable with `pip install -e third_party/ringer` from the HRM repository root.

The complete selected source snapshot is identified by file hashes.

See `SOURCE.json` for the supplied code hashes and source adaptations.

This selected package provides the geometry, reconstruction, data and model utilities used by HRM. Use the generation, projection and scoring commands in the [HRM guide](../../readme.md).
